task: conditional peptide generation (Stage 4 Route B), conditioned on tag tokens
base_model_loading: 4-bit NF4, frozen; base weights are downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub on first load and are not stored here
adapter: LoRA r=16, alpha=32, dropout=0.05 on c_attn; wte and lm_head also trained
training_data: 24172 sequences (DRAMP, ESCAPE, BAAMP, DBAASP) in 10385 identity clusters (>0.7 similarity); 21466 train / 2706 val, split by cluster
training_hyperparameters: lr 2e-4, effective batch 32, max_length 128; trained to epoch 12
